text:
sara: Heads-up: Hosted GA for two new endpoints is live — harbor-lite (cost-first) and harbor-x (throughput-first). Both support streaming + tool-calling and the new websocket multiplexing path. Docs: https://internal.redwood.dev/hosted/harbor-ga

deploy-bot: [deploy] harbor images rolled to canary us-east-1 -> 50% traffic. No errors in canary checks. :white_check_mark:

leo: Are we changing the default alias? will existing aliases break?

nina: Alias plan: no forced alias change immediately. We'll add harbor-x as an opt-in alias today. Automatic alias flip for the "harbor" alias scheduled in 7 days after a 72h metrics review. We'll post the exact schedule + customer contact list.

billing-bot: Note: harbor-lite maps to the hosted-lite SKU (0.55x token cost). harbor-x uses hosted-pro SKU; see price sheet in the doc. Customers on committed plans will see invoice adjustments next billing cycle.

ops-oncall: Ops notes: default streaming connections per pod bumped 20 -> 50. Connection pool tuning pushed to staging. New dashboards: /dashboards/harbor-streaming and /dashboards/harbor-toolcalls. Alert: sustained p95 token latency > 400ms for 5m -> page.

leo: Private/Dedicated customers — compatibility?

platform-eng: Dedicated patches will be published this week. On-prem customers need to update to runtime v1.14 and enable --enable-multiplexing and --tool-calls flags. We will provide a 2-line upgrade snippet in the guide.

support: Can we get a short customer-facing blurb for the support KB and status page?

nina: Draft blurb in the docs PR. Short version: "Harbor endpoints (harbor-lite, harbor-x) are now GA on Hosted API. Harbor-lite for cost-sensitive workloads; harbor-x for latency/throughput. Both support streaming and tool-calling. Contact support for migration help."

leo: Any SDK changes or deprecations?

docs-bot: SDK changes: streaming multiplexing added to all official SDKs (node/py/go) in v0.19.2. Changelog entry and migration snippets merged in PR #599. Deprecation: legacy streaming flag `stream_v1` will be removed in 45 days.

billing-bot: Reminder: customers using the legacy `stream_v1` flag may be billed at older rates until they migrate; see migration guide for quotas and cost estimators.

platform-eng: Quick migration snippet for Dedicated (bash):
```bash
# upgrade runtime and enable features
kubectl set image ds/hosted-runtime hosted-runtime=registry.redwood.io/hosted-runtime:v1.14
kubectl patch daemonset hosted-runtime -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"hosted-runtime","args":["--enable-multiplexing","--tool-calls"]}]}}}}'
```

sara: Rollout plan = staged canary -> 48h monitoring -> regional ramp -> global GA. We will notify customers with traffic > 10K tokens/day before the alias flip.

ops-oncall: Please run websocket multiplex smoke tests in staging and run the tool-calls flow against the test tool harness. If you hit 5xx or stream resets, tag @ops-oncall with logs.

support: We'll coordinate outgoing emails with product and legal. Please add the customer outreach list to the doc.

leo: Town hall?

nina: Town hall + Q&A tomorrow 09:00 PT in #product. Recording and slides will be posted in the doc.

sara: Great work team. Big milestone for Hosted. :tada:
